criteria.reasoning: Candidate demonstrated three categories of value-added work exceeding basic requirements: (1) Independent verification with annotations - cross-validated recommended weights against params_holdings.csv with explicit pass/fail for each asset, verified monitoring indicators (M1=-5.84%, M8=+7.23%) using cleaned data after removing weekend anomalies, calculated and documented 69 trading day gap; (2) Foolproof tips for error-prone specifications - explicit execution order warning showing wrong order would breach 8% cash下限 to -0.50%, detailed structural null vs data gap distinction preventing incorrect imputation, methodology clarification on multiplicative vs additive S&P 500 RMB returns; (3) Pointing out gaps in instructions/input materials - discovered Shibor/DR007 truncation flag mismatch (has_more=true but possible_truncation=false), identified weekend trading anomalies (2026-09-12 Saturday records), transparently reported rule requiring ≥20 windows is structurally unachievable with explicit handling approach, documented specific missing months in LPR/PMI/social financing series. criteria.name: N02
criteria.description: 给出结论但缺少对应的数据支撑（表格引用或可追溯的计算过程）。按违规程度评分：5=绝大多数结论无任何数据支撑；4=超过半数结论缺少数据支撑；3=约半数结论缺少数据支撑；2=仅个别结论缺少数据支撑；1=所有结论均有表格引用或可追溯的计算过程（无违规，翻转后计满分）。仅当发现明确证据证明存在缺少数据支撑的结论时判定成立。（设计态负分；落到 tests/rubrics.toml 时为 negate = true + 正 weight，Reward Kit 归一化后自动翻转计分） Deliverables to inspect: `/app/output/FIN3-WKN-149_风险委员会决策备忘录.md`.
criteria.reasoning: 文档中约25个主要结论，绝大多数都有明确的表格引用和数据支撑。例如：方案未通过检查的结论（第7-8行）有第192-210行的九项检查表和超限明细表支撑；监测指标触发结论（第9行）有第273-283行的监测指标表支撑；压力测试结果（第134行）有第136-169行的完整32条结果表支撑。仅有2处结论缺少显式的计算过程追溯：(1)第84行'境内权益三项合计风险贡献96.18%'虽然提供了各方案的具体数值，但未展示风险贡献的计算方法；(2)第243行'若先买后卖，现金占比将降至-0.50%'给出了具体结果但未展示计算步骤。这两处属于'仅个别结论缺少数据支撑'的情况，符合评分标准中的2分。
